pages.title: Getting started
pages.contentBrief: Use Node.js 24, pnpm 12, and Git. Real playback also needs FFmpeg, ffprobe, and an NVIDIA GPU with NVENC support. Offline unit and integration tests need no GPU or upstream credentials (`README.md`, `.nvmrc`, `package.json`). Run commands from the repository root.

pages.contentBrief: These terms connect shared contracts, the server pipeline, and client playback. Start with [architecture](architecture.md) for the runtime view.

pages.title: Lore
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream's complete available history contains **109 commits**, from `c0781bd` on **2026-11-05** to **`0a8f04fd81cfaa7ca5d1689550ad207e7fc0d3ae`** on **2026-11-08**. In about 79 recorded hours, a server foundation grows into a media pipeline, browser player, Electron shell, and richer browsing/settings UI. See [architecture](overview/architecture.md) for the current system and [by the numbers](by-the-numbers.md) for measurement rules.

pages.title: Contributing
pages.contentBrief: Start from `main`, keep changes focused, and finish with tests, current contracts, and an honest record of validation. `CONTRIBUTING.md` is the human guide; `AGENTS.md` supplies product constraints and agent rules.

pages.title: Development workflow
pages.contentBrief: Bootstrap once, branch from `main`, change code and contracts together, and run the checks appropriate to the change. Commands run from the repository root with Node 24 and pnpm 12 (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `package.json`).

pages.title: Debugging
pages.contentBrief: Start with local readiness, then identify configuration, upstream, playback, or storage failures. Request IDs connect API responses to local logs. Maintained procedures are indexed in `docs/runbooks/README.md`.

pages.title: Patterns and conventions
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream uses strict TypeScript, shared Zod contracts, thin routes, and explicit service construction. Follow `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and nearby code when changing behavior.

pages.title: Tooling
pages.contentBrief: pnpm workspaces and Turbo coordinate builds and checks. Repository scripts add code-size, dependency, privacy, generated-doc, and automation gates (`package.json`). See [workflow](development-workflow.md) for when to run them.

pages.title: Apps
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream ships a server, a browser client and an Electron shell. The server owns upstream credentials, SQLite and video encoding; clients consume shared contracts rather than importing server internals (`apps/server/src/app.ts`, `packages/shared/src/index.ts`).

pages.title: Server
pages.contentBrief: The Node 24/Fastify 5 server owns LAN HTTP, SSE, HLS, SQLite and media-tool processes. `buildApp` in `apps/server/src/app.ts` composes services; `main` in `apps/server/src/index.ts` activates listeners and background work.

pages.title: Screens
pages.contentBrief: The web routes implement browsing, search, title details, playback and Settings. This page covers presentation and notices; [player](player.md) and [desktop integration](desktop-integration.md) explain session and shell behavior.

pages.title: Navigation search
pages.contentBrief: One field in the navigation bar drives mixed movie/show search. The field stays in the initial shell; the results page loads lazily and does not duplicate the input. URL state, local typing and the debounced server request are deliberately separate (`apps/web/src/components/NavSearch.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/useNavSearch.ts`, `apps/web/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx`).

pages.title: Settings and spoilers
pages.contentBrief: Settings separates device/shell controls from read-only About information. Episode spoiler protection is a default-on browser-local preference, not a server setting or progress mutation. Tabs and device controls live in `apps/web/src/pages/settings/`; the reactive preference lives in `apps/web/src/lib/spoilers.ts`.

pages.title: Data and startup
pages.contentBrief: The client separates TanStack Query server data, route/component state, persistent device identity and small external stores for downloads, event-stream liveness and notices. Request code lives in `apps/web/src/api/`; SSE lives in `apps/web/src/events/`. There is no separate monolithic application-state store.

pages.title: Desktop integration
pages.contentBrief: The web build is also the implemented Electron renderer. `desktopBridge` and `inMiniPlayer` in `apps/web/src/desktop/bridge.ts` detect the preload's `window.homestream` interface and return browser-safe fallbacks. The renderer never imports the desktop app; contracts come from `packages/shared/src/desktop.ts`. The [desktop shell](../desktop/index.md) owns windows, IPC authorization, tray, process supervision and native notifications.

pages.title: Systems
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream separates session/process ownership, shared media-byte delivery and operational feedback. The composition root is `buildApp` in `apps/server/src/app.ts`.

pages.title: Playback
pages.contentBrief: `PlaybackManager` in `apps/server/src/playback/manager.ts` turns a title request into device-compatible HLS. It is a facade: focused modules handle admission, source attempts, encoding, recovery, serving and subtitles.

pages.title: Encoding
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream always re-encodes video with NVENC. `decide` in `apps/server/src/playback/decision.ts` chooses compatible output; `buildFfmpegArgs` in `apps/server/src/playback/ffmpegArgs.ts` implements decode, filters, audio and HLS muxing.

pages.title: Playback lifecycle
pages.contentBrief: A session cannot replace its video encoder until the previous child has actually exited. `SessionSlots` in `apps/server/src/playback/sessionSlots.ts` retains capacity across opening, live, failed-but-running and draining work; `Recovery` in `apps/server/src/playback/recovery.ts` serializes replacements.

pages.title: Subtitles
pages.contentBrief: Text tracks become progressive WebVTT renditions; bitmap tracks burn into video. `SubtitleHandoff` in `apps/server/src/playback/subtitleHandoff.ts` connects HTTP readiness to `SubtitleExtractor` in `apps/server/src/playback/subtitleExtractor.ts` and session-owned `SubtitleStore` in `apps/server/src/playback/subtitleStore.ts`.

pages.title: Source proxy
pages.contentBrief: `SourceProxy` in `apps/server/src/sourceproxy/proxy.ts` gives media tools opaque loopback handles while sharing remote bytes and probe results. `SourceEntry` in `apps/server/src/sourceproxy/sourceEntry.ts` owns one exact raw gateway URL's current location and cached data.

pages.title: Network controls
pages.contentBrief: Network controls bound remote media reads and advertise useful LAN addresses. `DownloadGate` in `apps/server/src/network/downloadGate.ts` schedules aggregate bytes; `ReadAheadWindow` in `apps/server/src/network/readAhead.ts` controls time hysteresis; `getLanAddresses` in `apps/server/src/net.ts` supplies server-info and discovery addresses.

pages.title: Gateway
pages.contentBrief: `GatewayClient` in `apps/server/src/gateway/client.ts` shares cached, rate-limited AIOStreams discovery and placeholder-aware playback probes. Real source URLs remain server-side; clients receive metadata and stable URL-derived IDs.

pages.title: Health
pages.contentBrief: `HealthService` in `apps/server/src/health/service.ts` combines dependency checks with live playback/network state. It is richer, slower and potentially more consequential than HTTP liveness/readiness.

pages.title: Telemetry
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream optionally reports scrubbed Sentry errors, typed PostHog events and feature flags. Server, browser and Electron main-process wiring are implemented; local logs/SSE/metrics work without cloud telemetry. `docs/PRIVACY.md` is the maintained disclosure. See [security](../security.md).

pages.title: Features
pages.contentBrief: These pages follow title workflows across server services and clients. Catalog browsing, cast/similar-title details, resume state and download notices feed playback, while the server owns upstream credentials and media processing (`apps/server/src/app.ts`, `apps/web/src/pages/PlayerPage.tsx`).

pages.title: Catalog
pages.contentBrief: Catalog normalizes TMDB metadata and combines it with local progress and pending downloads. `TmdbService` in `apps/server/src/tmdb/service.ts` owns upstream/cache access; `HomeService` in `apps/server/src/home/service.ts` assembles Home rows and featured choices.

pages.title: Stream selection
pages.contentBrief: Selection exposes URL-free source metadata and determines automatic playback order. `StreamService` in `apps/server/src/streams/service.ts` combines gateway lookup, episode filtering, parsing and device-aware recommendation; real probe/output policy belongs to [playback](../systems/playback/index.md).

pages.title: Prefetch
pages.contentBrief: Prefetch warms the cached source that automatic Play would recommend without creating a session, encoder or HLS files. `PrefetchService` in `apps/server/src/prefetch/service.ts` shares discovery/warming by media identity and display tier.

pages.title: Downloads
pages.contentBrief: Downloads persist tracking of remote TorBox caching, not complete media files downloaded to the PC. `DownloadService` in `apps/server/src/downloads/service.ts` asks the gateway to initiate uncached playback and polls until the title is actually listed as cached.

pages.title: Viewing progress
pages.contentBrief: Viewing progress persists shared resume state and derives Continue Watching/up-next cards. `PlaybackManager.ping` in `apps/server/src/playback/manager.ts` writes progress/history; `ContinueWatchingService` in `apps/server/src/progress/service.ts` builds visible entries from that data.

pages.title: Packages
pages.contentBrief: The repository has one internal package, [shared](shared.md), consumed by the [server](../apps/server.md), [web UI](../apps/web/index.md) and working [desktop shell](../apps/desktop/index.md). It holds cross-runtime contracts and pure policy, not application services.

pages.title: Shared contracts
pages.contentBrief: `@homestream/shared` exposes runtime Zod schemas, inferred TypeScript types and pure cross-runtime helpers through `packages/shared/src/index.ts`. The root export in `packages/shared/package.json` targets compiled ESM and declarations. There are no application imports, privileged desktop operations, network clients, database connections or telemetry SDKs.

pages.title: API
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream exposes JSON under `/api`, playback under `/hls`, and root-level operational probes. There is no authentication or `/v1` prefix: callers must be on a trusted LAN. See [security](../security.md).

pages.title: Security
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream trusts its local network and host. These are implemented boundaries, not an internet-readiness claim or a new security audit. `SECURITY.md` defines private reporting and supported versions; see [deployment](deployment.md).

pages.title: Monitoring
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream has local structured logs, durable events, health snapshots, Prometheus metrics and optional Sentry/PostHog telemetry. Dashboard tabs remain placeholders in `apps/web/src/App.tsx` and `apps/web/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPlaceholder.tsx`; their names do not imply a deployed monitoring UI. See [health](../systems/health.md).

pages.title: Logging
pages.contentBrief: Process logs, selected durable events and SSE are distinct channels in `apps/server/src/logger.ts`, `apps/server/src/events/record.ts` and `apps/server/src/routes/events.ts`. Use the request ID for HTTP context, event queries for domain history and SSE for live change notifications. See [monitoring](index.md).

pages.title: Metrics
pages.contentBrief: `ServerMetrics` in `apps/server/src/metrics/serverMetrics.ts` exposes **19 HomeStream metric families** through `GET /metrics`, plus Node/process defaults. Local metrics work with telemetry disabled; a scraper and any dashboard/notification backend are separate services (`apps/server/src/routes/ops.ts`).

pages.title: Tracing
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream implements request-ID correlation in `apps/server/src/requestContext.ts` and restricted Sentry error/breadcrumb reporting in `apps/server/src/telemetry/sentry.ts`, not a complete distributed tracing pipeline. Configuring a sampler or allowing trace headers does not create spans. See [logging](logging.md).

pages.title: Alerting
pages.contentBrief: HomeStream checks in eleven Prometheus expressions and two Sentry workflow definitions, not a provisioned paging system. Prometheus must load its rules and Sentry workflows must be applied separately; checked-in configuration is not proof of deployed monitoring (`monitoring/prometheus/alerts.yml`, `monitoring/sentry/alert-rules.json`).

pages.title: Configuration
pages.contentBrief: The server selects one env-format file, overlays recognized nonblank process variables and derives typed defaults. Restart after changes; browser build inputs and device-local preferences have different lifetimes (`apps/server/src/config.ts`, `apps/web/vite.config.ts`). See [getting started](../overview/getting-started.md).

pages.title: Data models
pages.contentBrief: SQLite stores durable state; active sessions, source-cache bytes, metrics, and HLS files have separate lifecycles. Shared Zod models define the public API rather than exposing SQL row shapes directly (`apps/server/src/db/index.ts`, `packages/shared/src/index.ts`). See [shared contracts](../packages/shared.md).
